docs.title: ScoreOn Documentation
docs.intro: ScoreOn is a system for managing grades, classes, and students, designed to make academic control easier for schools and teachers.

one.title: 1. Sign Up and Log In
one.text:
- Click "Get started" and create your account using Google or email.
- After logging in, you will access the main dashboard.

two.title: 2. Manage Classes
two.text:
- From the menu or home screen, click "Create class".
- Fill in the class name and the school year.
- Registered classes appear in a list where you can edit or delete them.

three.title: 3. Manage Students
three.text:
- Go to "My Students".
- Add new students and link them to a class.
- Edit or delete whenever needed.

four.title: 4. Enter Grades and Assessments
four.text:
- Open "Grades & Assessments".
- Select the class and the desired student.
- Enter grades and save.
- The system automatically calculates averages.

five.title: 5. View Reports
five.text:
- Generate performance reports by student, class, or subject.
- Export to PDF or Excel if needed.

faq.q1: Do I need to pay to use it?
faq.a1: No. ScoreOn is free for school use.
faq.a2: Yes. There is no limit of classes or students.
faq.a3: Yes. We use secure authentication and do not share your data.

exemplos.introducao: See in practice how to register classes, students, and record grades in ScoreOn. Follow the step-by-step guide below to understand the full process:

passo1.texto:
- Access the menu or click "Register class" on the home screen.
- Fill in the class name (e.g., 3rd Year A) and the school year (e.g., 2025).
- Click "Register". Your class will appear in the class list.

passo2.texto:
- Open the desired class and click "Add student".
- Provide the student's name, email, and other details.
- Save to link the student to the class.

passo3.texto:
- Select the class and the student.
- Click "Record grade" and fill in the assessment fields.
- Save to register the grade. The system automatically calculates the average.

passo4.texto:
- Go to the reports section.
- Choose the report type (by student, class, or subject).
- Export to PDF or Excel if desired.
